errors.evidence: Description states the error at rank 4 is approximately 0.34, but figure shows approximately 0.3. The error is stated to decrease to approximately 0.31 at rank 16, but figure shows approximately 0.35. It incorrectly reports 0.40 at rank 64; figure shows approximately 0.6, and reports 0.61 at rank 256; figure shows approximately 0.6.
Description notes a monotonic increase from rank 4 to rank 16, which is incorrect as the error actually increases from rank 4 to rank 16.
Description fails to mention that the y-axis has error values that go beyond 0.3 to approximately 0.6, not just 0.3, 0.6, and 0.9.
